title:100%小狼人:
★ Global Box Office: 130 Million TWD ★ 2021 Australian Directors' Guild Award Nominee for Best Direction in an Animation ★ Based on the book by children's author Jayne Lyons.

Freddy Lupin is set to succeed as the leader of his werewolf pack. He is confident that, just like his father Flasheart, he will become the most fearsome werewolf in history. However, during his first transformation on his 14th birthday, things go hilariously wrong when he turns into a literal... poodle?!

Freddy has until sunrise tomorrow to prove he has the heart of a wolf, or he faces permanent exile from the family. Summoning his courage, he embarks on an adventure but quickly loses his way in the dark city streets. He crosses paths with a streetwise stray named Batty, who helps him out, only for them both to be captured by dog catchers. Now, Freddy must overcome his adorable exterior, escape the pound, and deal with the meddling of a human named Foxwell Cripp. His journey to prove he is 100% Wolf has never been more challenging.
title:104歲哲代奶奶：一個人生活:
Sparking the phenomenal "Tetsuyo Craze," this heartwarming and highly-discussed film has garnered overwhelming acclaim. 

In a mountain town in Onomichi, Hiroshima, Grandma Tetsuyo Ishii lives alone in her old family home. A former elementary school teacher, she bid farewell to her husband of half a century at the age of 83. Since then, she has chosen to remain in her familiar home and community, living day by day while looking out for her niece, relatives, and neighbors.

As the years pass and the list of things she can no longer do grows, Tetsuyo continues to find clever ways to encourage herself. With a free spirit, she gradually adjusts her life to suit the present moment. This film observes Grandma Tetsuyo’s daily life from age 101 to 104, capturing not only the laughter and humor but also the inevitable goodbyes and physical pains of aging. Amidst the peaks and valleys of life, she holds onto small, meaningful rituals, proving that "living alone" does not mean being "lonely." Instead, it is a way of life—one that neither forces strength nor retreats from the world.

title:2026第二季駐村藝術家聯合發表:
**2026 Season 2 Resident Artist Exhibition**

**Dates:** 2026-07-25 ~ 2026-08-09
**Venue:** Treasure Hill Artist Village

The 2026 Season 2 Resident Artist Exhibition brings together eight groups of artists from Germany, South Korea, the United Kingdom, Switzerland, Thailand, and the United States. Spanning new media, music, sound, video, installation, and cross-disciplinary media, their works examine how the passage of time and social progress continuously reshape our environment and daily lives.

**Duangjai Phuchana-Prasert** collects and experiments with soil to understand the temporal cycles of site formation. **Nicolei Buendia Gupit** utilizes ceramics and video to explore the relationship between water resources and ecology, responding to the historical water systems of Treasure Hill. **TUNALEE** draws parallels between Treasure Hill and the Sanbokdoro (mountainside roads) of Choryang-dong in Busan, South Korea, using thin layers of video and shifting light to overlay traces of war, migration, and survival.

**Kevin Corcoran** and **Jacob Sin** expand their creative focus to the connections between multiple landscapes in Northern Taiwan. Their work traces a fluid axis across historical dimensions—from the water systems of Treasure Hill, the Xindian River, and the Tamsui River to urban development, the industrial ruins of Northern Taiwan’s coal mines, and the high-tech production systems of contemporary microchip factories.

**Eunjin Liu** adopts the perspective of Taiwanese Opera, using sound installations to trace Taipei’s migration history and explore how movement shapes local identity. **Céline Ducret** draws from breathing, tides, and emotional rhythms to explore the permeable relationship between the individual and the environment. **Leo Bailly-Barton** employs interactive games to guide the audience into the symbolic order, transforming the exhibition into a space of flow, negotiation, and reorganization.

The artists invite the audience to step into their works, experiencing the mutual infiltration of history, environment, and the body through movement and stillness, and collectively sensing the "becoming" of the world.

title:Compact Disc+記憶座標:
When an entire generation is forced to forget rather than choosing to, how can memory be preserved? Can friendship become a gentle yet persistent form of resistance? The camera follows the director and a close friend as they return to the black hole of memory; through low-key and restrained imagery, unspeakable emotions are left to ferment in the dark. More than just a documentary, this is a memorandum of youth written for one another—an exercise in collective remembering. Amidst gloomy times, through love and companionship, it pieces together a bewildered yet authentic portrait of a generation of Hong Kongers.

Unfolding as a tender letter, the film traces Hong Kong through its landscapes and lingering marks. Within memories of those who left, stayed, or drifted, it searches for intimate moments that quietly connect lives, attuned to the city’s subtle rhythms of change and stillness.

title:FUTURE VISION LAB 2026:
Since 2020, the C-LAB Future Vision Lab has spearheaded the experimental exhibition project "FUTURE VISION LAB." Beginning with digital experimental architecture, the lab created the "DOME" to continuously explore the visual limits of technological media, showcasing over 200 works over the past six years. In 2023, with the support of the Ministry of Culture, the lab completed hardware and software upgrades to create the "C-LAB Dome"—Taiwan's only giant mobile outdoor immersive space with a 15-meter diameter. The immersive projection system achieves an ultra-high resolution of 8K × 8K, overcoming complex technical challenges such as calibration, stitching, alignment, playback control, and pre-production for spherical surfaces. The venue features a double-layer structure equipped with custom acoustically transparent projection membranes and a 25.4-channel surround sound environment, delivering a high-specification immersive experience. Future Vision Lab continues to optimize the creative environment of the dome to align with international standards, showcasing Taiwan’s creative energy in the field of tech-art.

"FUTURE VISION LAB 2026" will take place over eight consecutive weekends from April 18 to June 7, 2026. It brings together exceptional works from Taiwan, France, Spain, Hungary, Austria, South Korea, Japan, the USA, and Canada, featuring a total of 19 works across 16 programs. Through a diverse range of formats including exhibitions, screenings, and live performances, the festival invites audiences into the C-LAB Dome to immerse themselves in a sensory experience woven from cross-national creative intersections and diverse cultures.

title:JSA共同警戒區 4K數位修復版:
The masterpiece that established director Park Chan-wook’s international reputation and became the highest-grossing South Korean film of its year, *Joint Security Area* returns for a limited 26th-anniversary 4K restored theatrical release. Through a cinematic lens that interweaves suspense and human nature, the film exposes both cruel realities and heartwarming humanity.

In the Joint Security Area (JSA) on the border between North and South Korea, two North Korean soldiers are shot dead one night under mysterious circumstances. Sophie, a Swiss-Korean female officer from a neutral nation, is dispatched to investigate the baffling case. As she peels back the layers of the investigation, she uncovers a shocking truth tied to a secret friendship that transcends national borders and historical animosity. Even as nations are pitted against each other by political hatred, a bond of brotherhood manages to cross the invisible 38th parallel. Through a seemingly casual yet precious photograph, the film conveys a profound yearning for peaceful coexistence.
title:Strike!娜英: "The best thing about bowling is that no matter if you got a strike last time, the next frame is always a fresh start." For Na-young, who has lived in a small seaside village her entire life, nothing is more important than taking care of her family. However, her world begins to shift as her mother tries to sell their cherished home filled with memories, and her younger brother insists on moving to Seoul. As Na-young struggles to navigate these sudden changes and her own sense of uncertainty, bowling unexpectedly enters her life. Spending more and more time at the bowling alley, she becomes captivated by the sport. Through learning the game, she gradually opens her heart and finds a renewed sense of hope for the future.

**【About the Artwork: *Mound*】**
*Mound* uses "play" as a metaphor for understanding human civilization. The traces left by daily activities accumulate over time, eventually transforming into historical ruins that can be traced back. The work is inspired by the various architectural eras of Yuanshan Park and the cultural remains unearthed at the Yuanshan Archaeological Site—including stone tools, wooden implements, and post-hole clusters—pointing to the "accumulations" formed by human life.

title:「冷戰認知敘事」系列座談Ｉ：黃立慧《時間的女兒》中的「誤讀」:
**Time:** Friday, July 10, 2026 | 19:30–21:30
**Location:** Multi-function Room 303, CREATORS Space, Taiwan Contemporary Culture Lab (C-LAB) (No. 177, Sec. 1, Jianguo S. Rd., Da’an Dist., Taipei City)
**Panelists:** Huang Li-hui (Artist), Wu Ssu-feng (Theater Critic), Chen Wei-chien (Art Critic)
**Moderator:** Chang Tsung-kun (PhD Student, Institute of Social Research and Cultural Studies, NYCU)

### ▍Talk Introduction
"Since she was a child, Li-hui felt that Ying-wu was different from others."

It all began with a "misreading": a father’s ideology and political beliefs were misidentified, leading to interrogation and imprisonment—a process that continues to this day, consolidated and institutionalized by historical archives, commemorations, and interpretations. Ying-wu repeatedly instructed Li-hui: "Don't get the general direction wrong." In an era where history has become a "struggle between memory and memory," what exactly is "correct"? How can one begin to unpack this without falling into further misreading? If "misreading" triggered the creation of *The Daughter of Time* years ago, then as the work enters the battlefield of discourse, how should we read—or resist misreading—once more? How do we navigate a path of practice through constant calibration and escape?

Since 2017, artist Huang Li-hui has been developing her *Family Soap Opera* series, which focuses on identifying how historical and national narratives are formed and circulated through the "family"—the fundamental unit of society—in the post-Cold War era. As the artist immerses herself in the creation of the series' finale, *910 Highview*, during her residency, this lecture series will trace the ten-year trajectory of *Family Soap Opera*. By examining individual works, the talks will re-evaluate the political and artistic contexts they inhabit to reflect on the positioning and strategy of her new work.

This retrospective also aims to confront the prevailing trends in art related to the White Terror and transitional justice that have emerged alongside this series. The lecture situates this historical background within the problem of "Cold War cognitive narratives," using three sub-themes—"Misreading," "Translation" (July 25), and "Artificiality" (August 11)—as clues. These correspond respectively to the series' sequential releases: *The Daughter of Time* (2017), *My Mother is a Good German* (2020), and *Alpinia B-side* (2021). The talk will further explore the historical environments behind these works and the Cold War concepts—or contemporary reflections—mirrored through generational sensibilities.

---

### ▍Artist Profile
**♦︎ Huang Li-hui**
A full-time artist, Huang holds an MFA in Art and Design from National Taipei University of Education (2008) and an MFA in Performance Art from the School of the Art Institute of Chicago (2013). Her work often stems from personal dilemmas, exploring the boundaries between individuals and collectives. She seeks to find the intersection between grand narratives and personal histories to expand the perceptual dimensions of her subjects. Her media include performance, video, and installation, with a particular focus on the temporal correspondence between live performance and documentary traces. Her decade-long series *Family Soap Opera* explores the gaps in collective narratives. She has been nominated for the 19th and 20th Taishin Arts Awards, and her work has been exhibited in Taiwan, the US, Germany, and Mexico.

---

### ▍Panelist Profiles
**♦︎ Wu Ssu-feng**
A theater critic and editor based in Hualien/Taitung. He participates in theater primarily through writing and editing, as well as curation and production.

**♦︎ Chen Wei-chien**
Currently a teacher of contemporary art for amateurs (Director of "Fat Teacher" Painting and Photography Studio) and an art critic. He served as a contributing critic for the Taishin Bank Foundation for Arts and Culture (2013–2024). His writings appear in *Artco*, *Artist Magazine*, and other media. He is the author of *Taiwan Photographers Series: Quo Ying-sheng* (2019). He is dedicated to contemporary art and hopes to make it more accessible through writing and teaching.

---

### ▍Moderator Profile
**♦︎ Chang Tsung-kun**
A PhD student at the Institute of Social Research and Cultural Studies, National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University. His research interests span the Cold War, infrastructure, and labor, with a focus on historical representation and its politics within the arts. His art criticism can be found in the *Performing Arts Review*, *PAR Magazine*, *ARTouch*, and *CLABO*.

title:「物質世界」策展人開講:
**Curator’s Talk: "The Material World"**

"Curator’s Talk" is a series hosted by the Taipei Fine Arts Museum (TFAM), inviting curators to provide in-depth guided tours and share their insights on specific exhibitions. In this session, curator Feng Hsin will lead an exploration of four thematic works within "The Material World."

**Event Time:** Saturday, July 11, 2026, 2:00 PM – 3:30 PM
**Venue:** 2nd Floor Exhibition Rooms, TFAM
**Check-in Location:** Entrance of Exhibition Room 2B
**Capacity:** 20 participants

**About the Event**
Matter shapes the way we live. From the moment we open our eyes, we are surrounded by material objects: the cups we drink from, the clothes we wear, the spaces we inhabit, and the smartphones that have evolved far beyond mere communication tools. Every facet of daily life—food, clothing, housing, transportation, and entertainment—is defined by matter. To meet the demands of life, objects are constantly created, invented, improved, and evolved. Humans use objects, and through that use, systems emerge. These systems, in turn, become intuitive actions in our daily lives; our postures, habits, and even our modes of thought are influenced by the things we use.

From Jean Baudrillard’s revelation of "sign value" in consumer society in the 1970s to Tim Dant and Bernard Stiegler’s exploration of "material practice" in the 1990s, matter is more than just a commodity or a reference of meaning. Through daily operation, use, and perception, it forms "object-derived technologies" that influence human patterns of action and the very fabric of society.

This exhibition looks back at the transition from agricultural to industrial and commercial society, examining how the production and circulation of matter have profoundly altered our world—from individual lifestyles to the large-scale mechanisms and hidden forces that drive social operations. We explore how matter continues to "generate" the world across different scales and perceptions, and how artists of different eras have translated the sensibilities of their times into material creations and experimental presentations, responding to the shifting perceptions and imaginations that accompany these changes.

**About the Speaker**
**Feng Hsin** is an Assistant Curator at the Taipei Fine Arts Museum. Her recent research focuses on the development of sound art, new media art, and contemporary cultural performance in Taiwan, as well as how digital technology influences public behavior and perception. 

Selected curatorial projects include: *Historical Variations* (2018, TKG+ Project), *Dynamic Layers* (2021, Museum of Contemporary Art Taipei), *Offline Reality* (2022, FreeS Art Space), and *Everyday Performance* (2024, Chiayi City Museum). She served as co-curator for the 2023 Romantic Route 3 Art Festival ("Travelers on the Foothills") and *Visible/Audible: Exhibition of Artifacts from Taiwan’s Film and Audiovisual History* (2022, Taiwan Film and Audiovisual Institute). She is also the co-author and editor of *Twenty Years of Contemporary Art Curating in Taiwan* (2015).

title:「鬱卒的平面：李亦凡／第61屆威尼斯國際美術雙年展台灣館」返台座談:
**Time:** Sunday, June 14, 2026, 2:00 PM – 3:30 PM
**Location:** Library and Resources Center, B1, Taipei Fine Arts Museum (TFAM)
**Moderator:** Chen Hsiang-wen | Independent Curator
**Panelists:** 
Li Yi-fan | Artist
Chien Cheng-yi | Head of Exhibition Planning, TFAM
Kao Tzu-chin | Head of Marketing and Public Relations, TFAM

**Event Introduction:**
The Taiwan Pavilion at this year’s Venice Biennale is represented by artist Li Yi-fan and curated by Raphael Fonseca. Titled "Screen Melancholy," the exhibition draws on the art historical concept of "melancholy" to respond to the anxiety and emotions triggered by the contemporary digital environment.

Li Yi-fan’s practice spans painting, animation, game engines, and generative imagery. Using dark humor and irony, he combines jump-cut visuals, tutorial-style monologues, and self-developed puppet systems to explore how images shape human perception, narrative, and self-understanding in an era of information overload. This exhibition marks Li’s first foray into site-specific creation; it continues his reflection on the systems of image production while responding to the historical and architectural context of the venue. This also marks the first time TFAM has transformed the entire space of the Palazzo delle Prigioni into a single multi-media image installation. The exhibition invites viewers into a space where the virtual and physical coexist, allowing them to experience the emotional shifts, intellectual dislocations, and perceptual fatigue of the digital age. It connects back to the core question of the exhibition: In a state of infinite information and finite life, how do people use "melancholy" as a way to respond to the world?

This forum invites artist Li Yi-fan to share his creative process, his journey to the Venice Biennale, and his on-site observations. The TFAM team will also reveal the behind-the-scenes stories of the Taiwan Pavilion, from the challenges of production and execution to how the exhibition engages in dialogue within the global contemporary art scene, providing the audience with a comprehensive understanding of this exhibition experience.

title:【嬰兒車電影院】巴亞拉魔幻冒險（國語）:
The Kingdom of Bayala was once a magical realm where elves and dragons lived in harmony. However, under the wicked schemes of Ophira, the Shadow Elf Queen, the dragon eggs were stolen, and Princess Surah of the Sun Elves was abducted to the Shadow Kingdom. This led to the disappearance of the dragons and caused the once-peaceful elven lands to slowly lose their magic.

Years later, after bravely escaping back to the Sun Kingdom, a grown-up Surah discovers that the dragons have not truly vanished. To save their world and restore magic to the land, the newly crowned Sun Queen, Eyela, decides to unite all the elven tribes and revive the long-lost "Dragon Feast." Entrusted with a vital mission, Surah and her friends embark on a perilous journey to escort a dragon egg and bring hope back to Bayala.
title:【嬰兒車電影院】皇家保姆亞瑟（國語）: Dark forces are plotting to kidnap seven royal heirs to force the Prince into surrendering his throne to an evil wizard. Amidst the chaos, Arthur the Goat unexpectedly becomes the protector of seven grumpy royal chicks. Though newly hatched, these chicks are strong-willed and full of distinct personalities. To defeat the dark wizard and save the kingdom, they must learn to work together. Through their journey, Arthur discovers the true meaning of family and the power of unity.
title:【嬰兒車電影院】紅鞋公主與七矮人（國語）: Seven handsome princes are transformed into seven dwarfs by a curse that can only be broken by a kiss from the most beautiful woman in the kingdom. Meanwhile, Snow White—whose natural appearance is a far cry from the dwarfs' ideal of beauty—stumbles upon a pair of magical red shoes that grant her a level of loveliness she never could have imagined. Will the seven dwarfs be able to secure a kiss from the fairest woman in the land to break the spell? But who is truly the most beautiful woman in the world, and what does "beauty" really mean?
title:【樂齡族電影院】大名倒產: By a stroke of luck, Matsudaira Koshiro unexpectedly becomes the lord of the Echigo Nyuyama Domain, only to discover he has inherited a staggering debt of 10 billion yen. They say money makes the world go round, but without it, life is a relentless grind. Since ancient times, the struggle for wealth has been a universal human challenge, and Koshiro is no exception. This engaging story follows Koshiro as he navigates this financial crisis, working alongside his friends to flip their fortunes and turn their lives around.
title:【樂齡族電影院】神選之地: In the late 19th century, a Danish priest travels to a remote part of Iceland with the mission of building a church and photographing its people. As he treks across the rugged, unforgiving landscape, the overwhelming forces of nature begin to erode his faith and ideals. Even as he settles into a small community to begin his ministry, the deeper he immerses himself in local life, the more he is confronted by human nature and temptation. Like the inverted images in a camera obscura, these forces distort his sense of purpose, leaving him adrift. With the harsh winter fast approaching, where will this journey ultimately lead him?
title:【聽．視界電影院】不能流淚的悲傷: From childhood sweethearts to the spark of young love, Zhao Xinhui (He Landou) and Lin Hancong (Cai Fanxi) were certain they were meant to spend the rest of their lives together. However, when faced with the strain of a long-distance relationship, family obligations, and a surprise confession from their senior, Chen Xiaoming (Greg Hsu), what choice will she ultimately make?
title:【聽．視界電影院】在你面前: An actress’s older sister returns to South Korea from the United States to reunite with her sibling. One morning, the two sisters meet for breakfast and a stroll. By noon, the older sister heads off to an appointment with a film director. After a few drinks, the director proposes collaborating on a film specifically tailored for her. She initially declines, revealing a secret she has been keeping close to her heart. The following morning, she wakes up to a text from the director claiming that everything he said the day before was merely a joke. Amused by the absurdity of it all, she looks at her sleeping sister and contemplates whether or not to share her deepest secret with her.
title:【聽．視界電影院】幸福巧克力: This moving documentary chronicles the true story of how a bakery owner, driven by a mission to support marginalized communities, founded Quon Chocolate. Located on a street corner in Toyohashi, Aichi Prefecture, the shop’s smooth textures and exquisite designs quickly earned it a loyal following. Quon Chocolate stands in a league of its own, with founder Koji Natsume’s ingenuity reflected in the brand’s diverse and creative offerings. Beyond the sweets, Natsume and his team are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace, providing a supportive environment for individuals with disabilities, single parents, those with limited education, and the LGBTQ+ community.
title:【聽．視界電影院】滿分之一秒: Can you let go of the pain of the past and move toward the future? Handpicked by the head coach, Jae-woo has made it to the finals of the national Kendo team selections. There, he must face Tae-su—the man who killed his older brother when they were children. However, Tae-su is an unstoppable force. Seeing Tae-su remain unscathed while he himself is unable to overcome him, Jae-woo is consumed by resentment. As training nears its end, Jae-woo grows increasingly volatile, and the rage he has harbored for years begins to reach its breaking point.
title:【聽．視界電影院】羅馬時光機: Rome, 1829. Bartolomeo is a wealthy and greedy man who covets a noble title above all else. In order to strike a secret deal with Prince Accoramboni and win the hand of his daughter in marriage, Bartolomeo must journey through the past, present, and future, overcoming a series of trials. Aided by several extraordinary companions, he will come face-to-face with his true self and discover a brand-new meaning to life.
title:【聽．視界電影院】速命道:
An ambulance and a mysterious sports car known as the "Hellcat" engage in a high-stakes duel, tearing from the docks and mountain passes onto the open highway. Within the city, their battle mirrors a legendary clash of masters atop Mount Wudang. Who will emerge as the next "God of Racing"? If only one can survive, who will have the last laugh?

Behind the wheel of the ambulance is Xiao Le, once a premier racer. After a tragic accident during a race with his older brother, Ah Jie, resulted in his brother's death, Xiao Le spiraled into self-destruction. It wasn't until he met Dr. Hui Hui that he found a new path, becoming an ambulance driver and vowing to "use speed to save lives."

However, the mysterious owner of the "Hellcat" has suddenly appeared, wielding a hit list of racers. Every driver he challenges meets a fatal end. Underground racing is a modern-day martial arts world; even when the price is life itself, it cannot stop these fanatics from their fateful pursuit of speed. As Xiao Le’s best friend, San Bao, begins to investigate, the hidden truth behind these accidents slowly comes to light.
title:【聽．視界電影院】鐵幕追緝令: Based on a true case from 1979, an investigator encounters one of the most terrifying serial killers in history. Set in the borderlands of Soviet Kazakhstan, rookie detective Sher Sadykov is assigned to a special tasks unit. His first case involves a serial killer who targets women. As the number of victims continues to rise, the investigation reaches a standstill—until Sher discovers that the killer has chosen his next target: his sister, who lives with him.
title:ㄟ！跟你說個祕密-大勇棒球隊: The children of the Dayong Baseball Team all share a dream of baseball, but every pitching error, missed swing, and lost game earns them a harsh scolding from their coach. Fortunately, they have each other’s company, allowing them to keep playing with a lighthearted and resilient spirit. A child’s "secret" might be a painful memory, social anxiety, or a complex, unspoken relationship with their family. When we approach these children with our cameras, we find that their eyes are clearer than adults could ever imagine. They are navigating their own survival strategies in their own way; through this series, we hope to accompany them on a journey "towards their secrets."
title:一一【25周年4K數位修復版】: Eight-year-old Yang-Yang is growing up in a middle-class family in Taipei. His father, the general manager of a computer company, finds himself at a crossroads in both his business and his marriage. His mother, Min-Min, overwhelmed by the monotony of caring for her bedridden mother, decides to seek a change. Meanwhile, his older sister Ting-Ting, a student at Taipei First Girls' High School, is navigating the restless stirrings of youth. Yang-Yang enjoys taking photos of the backs of people's heads, observing the adult world through his own lens to capture the "hidden side" that his family cannot see. In the city, people appear close, yet each carries their own unavoidable struggles. When faced with life’s questions, the answers may not be complex, but they are never quite perfect.
title:一個寶包三個爸:

In an apartment in the heart of Paris, roommates Pierre, Michel, and Jacques fully embrace their bachelorhood, living a carefree life of parties and romance. Amidst the revelry, a friend of Jacques’s sneakily asks him for a favor: to look out for an important "package" arriving the next day. Jacques agrees without a second thought, only to realize he has to leave town himself. He hastily leaves instructions for his two roommates and departs.

The next day, Pierre and Michel open the door and find themselves staring into a pair of wide, innocent eyes looking up from a cradle. They are utterly shell-shocked—how could the "package" be a baby?!

As suave as these three bachelors are in the adult world, they are completely out of their depth when it comes to caring for an infant. Director Coline Serreau masterfully uses contrast to generate humor while challenging traditional societal stereotypes regarding family roles and gendered divisions of labor. A massive box office hit in France that even outperformed *First Blood*, the film was famously remade by Hollywood as *Three Men and a Baby*.
title:一戰再戰: Barber, a veteran of numerous resistance movements, gradually stepped away from the front lines years ago to raise his daughter. Little did he know that his past would catch up with him sixteen years later when a soldier named Stephen suddenly appears, launching a massive operation to hunt down Barber’s daughter. Driven into a corner with nowhere to run, Barber is forced to reconnect with his former revolutionary comrades and team up with his daughter’s teacher to launch a daring rescue mission.
title:下課時間－失物招領箱:
Produced by the Australian Children's Television Foundation and adapted from the book series of the same name, *Little Lunch* is a series about the funny things that happen on the school playground during recess. The stories revolve around a group of unique and charming primary schoolers: Rory, Battie, Tamara, Melanie, Debra-Jo, and Atticus. When Debra-Jo loses her glasses, the whole gang heads to the Lost and Found to help her look—only to find that everyone ends up being reunited with their own long-lost treasures!

title:不代罪的羔羊: In a neighborhood on Réunion Island, as Eid al-Adha approaches, a young boy is taunted by his classmates as an "animal killer" because of his family's traditions. When a goat is delivered to his home, he decides to do whatever it takes to protect it—but the neighbors are watching closely. This is a moving story about courage, choice, and friendship.
title:不平凡的愛:
Kozo, the son of the Tsugawa Hospital director, returns home from his studies abroad and reunites with his former lover, Katsue, at a welcome party. Once a nurse, Katsue has since become a singer known for her clear, beautiful voice, raising her young daughter Amin as a single mother. Their old flame is rekindled, and Kozo insists on proposing despite their different social standings. However, his family creates obstacles, demanding that Katsue leave her daughter behind if she wishes to marry into the family. Torn between her vow of love and her own flesh and blood, what choice will she make?

Based on the novel *Aizen Katsura*, which has seen numerous screen adaptations, multi-talented director Cheng Tung-shan first adapted the Japanese film into a stage play before remaking it as this Taiwanese-language film starring Shi Jun and You Juan. While the original focused on a tragic romance defined by class barriers and misunderstandings, this version places greater emphasis on the silent sacrifice of maternal love and the "orphan girl" trope common in Taiwanese-language cinema. Supporting actresses Ling Ling, Chen Chiu-yen, and Cheng Hsiao-fen deliver feisty, outgoing performances as nurses, breaking the conservative gender and class constraints of the Japanese original while highlighting female friendship through humor. Additionally, the tear-jerking performance of child prodigy Hsiao Mu-lan masterfully captures the deep familial bonds central to Taiwanese melodrama.
title:世外:

After death and before reincarnation, departed souls arrive at a mystical realm known as "The Beyond." Here, Spirit Guardians spend their days guiding souls toward their next lives. This cycle continues until a young Spirit Guardian, Little Ghost, encounters "Little Sister," a soul who refuses to move on. Through her, the once-emotionless Little Ghost begins to see The Beyond in a completely different light.

As he attempts to lead her toward rebirth, Little Ghost uncovers the regrets of her past life. Overwhelmed by fury, Little Sister triggers an irreversible curse. If she is completely consumed by her hatred, both The Beyond and the mortal realm will be reduced to ash along with her.

Little Ghost convinces the Celestial Maiden to grant Little Sister a final chance at redemption. The Maiden dispatches the formidable warrior Heitian to accompany them on a perilous quest spanning a thousand years. Despite the constant dangers, Little Ghost repeatedly risks his own life to save her, hoping only that Little Sister can let go of her past pain, forgive herself, and finally step lightly onto the path of reincarnation.

Lord Hidetora Ichimonji, a Sengoku-era warlord who once dominated the battlefield with peerless authority, finds himself weary and aging at seventy. He decides to abdicate and divide his castles among his three sons. However, his eldest son immediately turns against him, subjecting him to humiliation and forcing him into exile. His second son also plots betrayal, treating his father with cold indifference. Only the third son—who was banished for his blunt honesty—secretly sends protection and warmly welcomes his exiled father. Witnessing the bloody fratricide of his lineage and tormented by the sins of his past, the once-mighty Hidetora descends into madness, silenced by the cruel tides of fate.

A thematic counterpart to *Kagemusha* that reaches even greater artistic heights, the film masterfully weaves Shakespeare’s tragedy *King Lear* into the Japanese Warring States period. Tatsuya Nakadai’s profound acting creates an intense emotional resonance, serving as the cornerstone of the film’s grand epic spirit. Although the production reused costumes and props from *Kagemusha*, it still cost $10 million to stage its massive battle sequences—a record-breaking budget in Japanese cinema at the time. The result is Akira Kurosawa’s ultimate masterpiece, the culmination of a lifetime of cinematic mastery.
title:二百三高地:

The Meiji Restoration propelled Japan into the ranks of the world's leading powers. Its expansionist ambitions toward Northeast China and Korea provoked the Russian Empire, a traditional European power, bringing the two nations to the brink of war. To secure control over Port Arthur, the Russian army constructed what was considered the most formidable fortress in military history on the nearby "203 Hill," prepared to deliver a crushing blow to the Japanese. General Maresuke Nogi, fiercely loyal to the Emperor, led the well-equipped Third Army, determined to seize this strategic stronghold at any cost.

In a departure from his role in *Kagemusha* released that same year, Tatsuya Nakadai portrays the "War God" Nogi with restrained, commanding authority. His nuanced performance captures the crushing emotional toll of duty, a legendary portrayal that moved audiences to tears. Toei spared no expense in creating magnificent sets, enlisting Toshio Masuda—renowned for his war epics—to direct. The film’s contrast between brutal, bloody combat and the pure essence of the Bushido spirit sparked intense debate and ignited a trend for large-scale war spectacles. Following the normalization of diplomatic relations between Japan and China in 1972, Japanese films were banned from import in Taiwan; this film was screened only once during the inaugural Golden Horse International Film Exhibition in 1980 and has not been released there since.
title:人生海海:

After years of working in Taiwan, Ah Yao returns to his hometown to handle his father’s funeral alongside his younger siblings. However, the proceedings are disrupted when the Religious Affairs Bureau intervenes, attempting to seize the father’s remains. In the face of this sudden conflict, the three siblings react in starkly different ways: the eldest brother, Ah Yao, chooses to yield; the younger brother, Ah Cai, opts for direct confrontation; and their sister, Shui Yun, struggles to maintain the sanctity of the ritual and order.

As the funeral progresses, long-buried family secrets begin to surface—tales of smuggling, migration, illness, and the lifelong struggle to obtain legal identification. Caught between memory and reality, the three are forced to re-examine their father and confront their own sense of belonging in this land.
title:人間的條件 第一部 純愛篇・第二部 激怒篇:

In 1943, Kaji, a man driven by humanist ideals, travels with his wife Michiko to the Tiger Ridge mine in Manchuria to serve as a wartime labor supervisor. He attempts to reform the colonial system from within and improve the treatment of prisoners of war, but he is constantly marginalized by bureaucrats and pressured by the military, all while failing to win the trust of the mistreated Chinese laborers. As the machinery of war relentlessly strips away his choices, Kaji finds himself increasingly isolated. How can he protect the dignity of those around him? And how can he preserve his own conscience as a human being?

Following *Black River*, a young Tatsuya Nakadai collaborates with director Masaki Kobayashi for the second time. His righteous and restrained performance captures Kaji’s impossible dilemma, marking a major breakthrough in his acting career. This realist masterpiece, adapted from Junpei Gomikawa’s novel of the same name, stands as a pinnacle of Japanese anti-war cinema. Cinematographer Yoshio Miyajima’s static shots and black-and-white widescreen photography establish a steady, solemn visual style, grounding this cinematic epic in a cold and piercing gaze at reality.
title:他們要殺你: A young woman (Zazie Beetz) must survive a night in the Vedge building, navigating a den of mysterious and twisted death traps controlled by a demonic cult, or risk becoming their next sacrifice. Produced by Andy Muschietti, the acclaimed director of the horror classic *IT*, and visionary director Kirill Sokolov, this film is an epic collision of horror, suspense, and comedy. Interweaving carnage with wicked dark humor, it makes a bold and shocking debut with its unique, wild, and alternative style.
title:仲代達矢，為演員而活:
In 1975, Tatsuya Nakadai and his creative partner and wife, Kyoko Miyazaki, co-founded the acting school Mumeijuku. Nakadai personally oversees talent selection and intensive training, maintaining a rigorous schedule from 6 a.m. to 8 p.m. When performing, he suppresses his own presence, allowing only the character to collide with his scene partner. Mumeijuku does more than just train actors; it cultivates "human beings" capable of standing on their own in the world, producing a steady stream of talent for 50 years. Yet, beneath his roles as a teacher and a performer, Nakadai’s true self is that of a humble actor who hand-copies his lines with a calligraphy brush and pastes them on his bedroom walls for constant memorization. 

Director Hidetaka Inozuka spent over a year following Nakadai, capturing the training process at Mumeijuku and its theatrical performances. Interspersed with interviews with Nakadai and his disciples, the film documents a side of him rarely seen by the public. At the time of filming, Nakadai was in his 80s, yet he remained steadfast on his beloved stage, battling a fading memory and declining physical strength. He continues to embrace the "beginner’s mind" of his early days as a "nobody," fulfilling his life’s mission—to live for the craft of acting—and passing this conviction on to the next generation.
title:俠女數位修復版: During the Ming Dynasty, the high-ranking official Yang Lian is murdered by the eunuch Men Da of the Eastern Depot. His descendant, Yang Huizhen, along with General Shi and other members of the Donglin faction, are relentlessly pursued by the secret agent Ouyang Nian. While in hiding, Yang develops a romantic bond with the scholar Gu Shengzhai, and through Gu’s strategic brilliance, they manage to outwit and defeat their pursuers. After giving birth to a son, Huizhen secretly leaves Gu, seeking to renounce the world and enter a Buddhist monastery. As the first Chinese-language film to win an award at one of the three major European film festivals, its iconic bamboo forest duel has profoundly influenced directors such as Ang Lee, Zhang Yimou, and Tsui Hark.
title:兔嘲男孩: ☀️ I hope the weather is good. See you on the rooftop.
title:全面啟動: Dom Cobb is a master thief, unparalleled in the high-stakes world of corporate espionage. His specialty lies in the most dangerous and mysterious realm: the subconscious. He infiltrates the minds of his targets while they are in their most vulnerable state—deep sleep—to steal their most guarded secrets. This extraordinary talent, combined with cutting-edge technology, has made him the ultimate prize in the world of corporate intrigue, but it has come at a devastating cost. Now an international fugitive, Cobb has lost the family he loves. However, a rare opportunity for redemption arises, offering him one last chance to reclaim the life he lost.
title:兩相好（數位修復版）:

Dr. Huang, a local Taiwanese practitioner of Western medicine, and Dr. Chen, a Mainlander practitioner of Traditional Chinese medicine, live next door to each other. The two families are in constant friction due to language barriers and differing customs. To make matters worse, the younger generation falls in love, escalating the neighborhood conflict and forcing everyone to reconsider the distance between them.

This film marks a pivotal turning point for director Li Hsing as he transitioned from Hokkien-language cinema to Mandarin-language cinema. It was the inaugural production of "Zili Film Company," founded by Li and his family, and served as the acting debut of Wang Man-chiao. While borrowing the comedic framework of ethnic conflict seen in Hong Kong MP&GI’s *The Greatest Civil War* series, the film shifts the root of the conflict to the misunderstandings and barriers caused by the language gap between local Taiwanese and Mainlanders. Li Hsing continues the "binary character" structure common in his Hokkien films, driving the plot through a progression from conflict to alliance. This mixed-language comedy serves as a culmination of his experience in Hokkien cinema. Notably, the film concludes with documentary footage of temple fair processions, preserving Taiwan's precious folk customs of the time in a "quasi-ethnographic" manner.

* This screening provides audio description services in Mandarin and Hokkien. Equipment is limited and prioritized for the visually impaired. If required, please visit the service counter on the 1st floor as early as possible to make a reservation. For detailed regulations, please refer to the official website.
title:兩隻小鳥: A little black bird and a little white bird live together in a big tree, leading a peaceful and happy life. However, whenever something new happens, they start bickering, each trying to outdo the other. Through the simple daily lives of these two feathered protagonists, this story uses a lively and engaging way to talk to children about tolerance, jealousy, and friendship...
title:公路上的遊牧人生 索: To escape domestic violence, a woman becomes a truck driver to raise her child independently. The film follows her onto the open road, delving into the male-dominated subculture of the trucking community. For these modern nomads, the highway is a way of life; traveling day and night, they face long separations from their families, poor security, labor exploitation, and health issues, sometimes relying on stimulants just to keep working. Along the way, makeshift roadside diners become vital sanctuaries for rest, connection, and solace.
title:六張臉：狂言師的舞台人生:
Ninety Years on the Path of Kyogen: The Artistic Pinnacle of Living National Treasure Nomura Mansaku

Directed by Japan Academy Prize-winning director Isshin Inudo, with gentle narration by award-winning actor Joe Odagiri.

Artistry like the bright moon—profound and beyond reach.

Kyogen is a traditional Japanese performing art with a legacy spanning over 650 years, using laughter to depict the full spectrum of human emotion. A leading figure in the world of Kyogen, Living National Treasure Nomura Mansaku has dedicated himself to the craft for ninety years since his stage debut at the age of three. In 2023, he was honored with the Order of Culture. This documentary provides an intimate look at Master Nomura Mansaku as he approaches his 94th year, capturing the special occasion of his commemorative performance.

The chosen program is the classic Kyogen play *Kawakami*, a piece he has refined in recent years that poignantly explores the love between a husband and wife. The story follows a blind man who makes a pilgrimage to "Kawakami Jizo." Though his sight is miraculously restored, he is faced with a cruel trial in a dream: the deity demands that he divorce his wife. Caught between the gift of sight and the love of his life, the man faces his most agonizing decision.

Through masterful cinematography, the film not only preserves this pinnacle of performance but also captures the master’s disciplined presence backstage—the silhouette of a true craftsman in pursuit of ultimate beauty.
title:再見了，可魯：數位經典重映:
In a cozy home in Tokyo, five Labrador puppies are born. One among them stands out, possessing a unique cross-shaped black birthmark on his belly and a temperament that is both gentle and intelligent. Filled with hope, his owner dreams of him becoming a guide dog for the visually impaired. Through her tireless efforts, he is eventually sent to a training center to begin his professional journey.

His name is Quill. Leaving his familiar home for the first time, he faces the first true test of his life. Under the devoted care of a foster family, Quill gradually learns to build trust and a deep bond with humans, preparing himself for rigorous training and the challenges ahead. With his innate loyalty, he will accompany Watanabe (played by Kaoru Kobayashi), a visually impaired man, through every moment of their daily lives...
title:切腹:
1962 Kinema Junpo Top 10 Japanese Films (3rd Place)
1963 Cannes Film Festival Special Jury Prize
1963 Blue Ribbon Awards for Best Actor & Best Screenplay

In 1630 (the seventh year of the Kanei era), the centralized rule of the third Tokugawa Shogun, Iemitsu, weakened the power of the daimyo houses, leaving once-proud samurai to wander as masterless ronin. During this time, many ronin began extorting money from daimyo estates by threatening to commit ritual suicide (seppuku) on their grounds—a nuisance that plagued many, including the prestigious Ii clan. One day, an elderly ronin named Tsugumo Hanshiro arrives at the Ii estate, requesting a place to commit seppuku. The clan's retainers decide to call his bluff, intending to force him to follow through with the act. However, as the old man slowly recounts the story of his journey, his true intentions are gradually revealed.

Following *The Human Condition*, Tatsuya Nakadai and Masaki Kobayashi collaborate once again. Based on Yasuhiko Takiguchi's novel *Ibun Ronin-ki* and written by legendary screenwriter Shinobu Hashimoto, the film employs a non-linear narrative to build a masterful atmosphere of suspense. Captured by cinematographer Yoshio Miyajima, known for his grand visual scale, the film depicts a tragic and brutal tale of revenge. In an era and nation that glorified the code of Bushido, this film offers a bold and scathing critique—a spirit that Tatsuya Nakadai has frequently praised, citing this as one of his favorite works.
title:刺蠻王:
The swordsman Jin Shange originally intended to serve his country by joining the ranks of Marshal Zhang Zhe. However, he was framed for the murder of the Prime Minister's son and sentenced to exile at the frontier. During his transport, the escort was ambushed by Jin soldiers; in the chaos, Jin Shange broke free from his shackles, defeated the enemy, and escaped.

Meanwhile, Marshal Zhang Zhe was killed by the Jin commander, Wanyan. The Marshal's daughter, Enzhu, managed to flee to Lu Village with the help of Wang Feng. Seeking vengeance, they began recruiting heroes to their cause. Jin Shange happened to pass by their martial arts tournament, where his peerless skills impressed Wang Feng, who invited him to join the resistance against the Jin invaders. Jin Shange readily agreed, but on one condition: he must marry Enzhu. To avenge her father, Enzhu consented, provided that Jin Shange first return with Wanyan’s head.

Jin Shange initially presents himself as a decadent, roguish, and even lecherous figure, subverting the traditional "chivalrous hero" archetype of wuxia cinema. As the group unites to fight the Jin, this unconventional warrior gradually redeems his image, ultimately making a stylish, solitary exit reminiscent of a classic Western hero.
title:劇場版「暗殺教室」：我們的時光: It is a day in late February; exams have ended, and graduation is just around the corner. Under the government’s increasingly strict surveillance, the students of Class 3-E look back on the year they spent with Koro-sensei. Memories flood back—the washable tattoo graffiti they drew on Ms. Bitch, the special swimming lessons, the rivalry with Class A, and Valentine’s Day chocolates—filling the classroom with nostalgic laughter and chatter. Meanwhile, despite being hunted by a quartet of assassins during winter break, Koro-sensei evaded them with his usual effortless ease.
title:動物哇哈哈-魯蛇獅減重大作戰: A lazy, gluttonous "loser" lion has grown so fat that he can’t even catch an antelope. After failing miserably time and again, he resolves to lose weight and get fit. Finally, he manages to catch up with the agile antelope, ready to feast... on sports drinks together!
title:動物哇哈哈：斑馬好忙: A work by German animation director Julia Ocker, this short animated comedy features a minimalist visual style and brisk pacing. Unique and full of humor, it is a lighthearted and delightful experience.

**[Artist Talk] Browsing the Site | Every Iris on the Internet (The First 100,000)**

**Time:** Thursday, May 21, 2026 ‧ UTC+8 20:00–21:30
**Location:** Online Talk
**Speaker:** Anna Ridler
**Discussant:** Clara Che Wei Peh
**Moderator:** Huang Xiang-yun
**Registration:** Please visit the exhibition page for *The Reaction of Disappearance* (click this link).
The online link for this event will be emailed to registrants two days prior (May 19). The 90-minute session will include consecutive interpretation (Mandarin/English) and a Q&A session, conducted bilingually.

**About the Talk**
Artist Anna Ridler, joined by discussant Clara Che Wei Peh, will lead the audience through a live online browsing of her work *Every Iris on the Internet (The First 100,000)* (2025). During this guided tour, the two will discuss the commonalities in their artistic practices and research methodologies. They will explore how this work reflects their shared research interests: deconstructing how data is enshrined as a modern myth, speculatively reimagining the futures of history and ecology, and examining how intricate systems of control shape both human and non-human worlds.

**Speaker | Anna Ridler**
Anna Ridler is an artist and researcher whose work explores systems of knowledge and how technology is invented and used to understand the world, particularly the natural world. Her practice often begins with data collection, using datasets to develop strange new narratives. Her work has been exhibited at numerous major international cultural institutions, including Times Square (New York), the Barbican Centre (London), Centre Pompidou (Paris), HeK (House of Electronic Arts, Basel), The Photographers' Gallery (London), ZKM Center for Art and Media (Karlsruhe), Ars Electronica (Linz), and the Victoria and Albert Museum (London). She was selected by *Artnet* as one of nine "pioneer artists" exploring the creative potential of AI and was nominated for a Golden Nica in the "Artificial Intelligence & Life Art" category at Ars Electronica in 2019.

**Discussant | Clara Che Wei Peh**
Clara Che Wei Peh is a curator and art critic based in Singapore. As the founder of Common Protocol, she is dedicated to promoting new media art practices in Southeast Asia. She also initiated Monday Chatroom, a touring discussion series focused on issues at the intersection of art and technology. Her curatorial projects have been presented at institutions such as The Institutum, ArtScience Museum, and DECK Photography Art Centre. Previously, she served as the Public Programmes Curator for the Asymmetry Art Foundation, an Asian Collections Researcher for the KADIST Art Foundation, Curator of the Digital section at Art Dubai, and an adjunct lecturer at LASALLE College of the Arts. Her research and criticism have appeared in the *Asian Art Biennial Reader*, *ArtAsiaPacific*, *The Brooklyn Rail*, and *Art and Market*. Currently, she is a member of The Lumen Prize International Selectors Committee and has served as a nominator for the LG Guggenheim Award and an external reviewer for SIGGRAPH Asia. You can follow her on Instagram: @claralikesart.

**Moderator | Huang Xiang-yun**
Huang Xiang-yun is a researcher in the philosophy of art and a visual artist. Her research focuses on post-colonialism, cyberfeminism, digital materialism, and critical AI theory, exploring the relationship between the "body" and "technology" through these lenses. She has curated exhibitions and performances including the online exhibition *Stuck? Click Me* (in collaboration with Aksioma, Slovenia, and KUNSTSURFER, Switzerland), *www.reverse-database.commons* at the Taipei Fine Arts Museum, *Our Terms, Our Conditions* at the IMPAKT Festival, *Fragments of Truth* at the Taipei Digital Art Festival, and the *Body Interface Project*. Her dance films and performance videos often stem from her own poetry, exploring the vulnerability of (non)human existence, collective mourning, and digital intimacy. Her work has been supported by the Mondriaan Fund (Netherlands) through the "New Artist Grant" and the National Culture and Arts Foundation (Taiwan). Her works have been exhibited at MOCA Taipei, the Cinedans Festival & Eye Filmmuseum (Netherlands), the Museum of Contemporary Art Belgrade, Ars Electronica, the Kikk Festival (Belgium), and panke.gallery (Berlin).

title:南北一家親:
Food is the soul of the people, but for two portly rivals, the dining table is a battlefield. In the 1960s, Leung Sing-po, owner of a Cantonese restaurant, and Liu En-chia, who runs a Northern-style eatery, resort to every trick imaginable to steal each other's business, bringing the deep-seated cultural differences between North and South to the surface. To their horror, their children fall in love, sending the two fathers into a rage. The feud escalates from verbal sparring to full-blown fisticuffs, with "Shadowless Kicks" and "Mount Tai Presses" flying, eventually forcing the young couple to stage a fake elopement. Can the two fathers set aside their prejudices for their children’s sake and turn their rivalry into friendship?

Following the massive success of the 1961 film *The Greatest Civil War* (directed by Wong Tin-lam and written by Stephen Soong), MP & GI struck while the iron was hot the following year. Producer Stephen Soong invited Golden Horse-winning screenwriter Chin Yu to provide the original story and commissioned the legendary Eileen Chang to pen the screenplay. Infusing MP & GI’s signature warmth with a slapstick energy, Chang crafted a vibrant North-South comedy rich in local wit and cultural clashes.
title:原鄉人數位修復客語版: Writer Zhong Li-he falls in love with Zhong Ping-mei, but because they share the same surname, their relationship faces fierce opposition from their families. The two elope to Shenyang, hoping to build a new life in their ancestral homeland. After the Second Sino-Japanese War ends, the Zhong family returns to Taiwan. Settling into a quiet life in Meinong, Zhong Li-he falls ill from the physical toll of balancing teaching and writing. It is only through Ping-mei’s unwavering support and care that he is able to spend his sleepless nights pursuing his literary dreams on manuscript paper. The film’s theme song, performed by Teresa Teng, further resonates with the hearts of the public.

title:名偵探柯南：黑鐵的魚影:
★ The 26th feature film in the "Detective Conan" series ★
Nominated for Best Animation Film at the 2024 Japan Academy Film Prize.

At "Pacific Buoy," an offshore facility located near Tokyo’s Hachijo-jima island, preparations are underway to launch a real-time surveillance system connecting police agencies worldwide. At the same time, a new facial recognition technology is being tested. Conan receives a call from Subaru Okiya, informing him that an Interpol agent has been murdered in Germany by Gin. Meanwhile, a female engineer is kidnapped from the facility by the Black Organization, and a USB drive containing critical information falls into their hands. As the danger escalates, a mysterious shadow silently creeps toward Haibara on Hachijo-jima...
title:向世界說聲嗨-歐亞河貍: Did you know that Eurasian beavers are the "underwater architects" of the wetlands? Born in the spring, beaver kits learn to swim within a month and store food underwater before winter arrives. By building dams, they alter water currents and enrich the wetland ecosystem. Once driven to the brink of extinction by hunting, they are now protected but still face the ongoing challenges of river development. This is a story about family and coexistence with the environment. *Say Hi to the World* is both an animated documentary and a narrative short film that uses an innovative, unconventional approach to tell the stories of various animals' births and lives.
title:呼吸練習:
★ Official Selection, 46th Golden Harvest Awards

That summer, Mother was hospitalized once again. Yi-ling felt adrift, burdened by the secrets of her birth and the sudden, inexplicable jealousy of her older sister, Si-qing. Through the repetition of daily life, they practice breathing with all their might, while learning to face the day that death inevitably arrives.
title:哈姆奈特: England, 1580. William Shakespeare, a struggling Latin tutor, meets the free-spirited Agnes. Deeply drawn to one another, they embark on a passionate romance and quickly marry, building a happy life with their three children. However, as William’s theatrical career flourishes in distant London, Agnes is left to anchor their home alone. When a sudden tragedy strikes, the couple’s once-unbreakable bond is pushed to its limits—an experience that would eventually inspire Shakespeare’s immortal masterpiece, *Hamlet*.
title:喀布爾，信仰之間:
Amidst the echoes of prayer and rifles slung over shoulders, faith and weaponry define the everyday. Two devout Afghan brothers live within this world: the elder patrols his post, dreaming of martyrdom while burdened by mundane worries; the younger, still a child, spends his days herding, playing, and reciting scripture, looking up to his brother with an innocence written across his face. Eschewing judgment for an open lens, the film offers a microscopic look at the coming-of-age of males under Taliban theocracy. What outsiders perceive as indoctrination is, to them, a sense of fulfillment and redemption, leaving the audience caught between empathy and profound shock.

title:回家路上: Along the six-kilometer stretch of Tao 5 Road, a military airfield sits on one side and a civilian airport on the other, bearing witness to the evolution of Taiwan’s military and economic landscape. From the pre-war Japanese colonial era and Cold War-era military cooperation between Taiwan and the U.S., to the construction of Taoyuan International Airport in the 1970s and the current Taoyuan Aerotropolis project, this corridor of history has seen the air force base fade into the past and military dependents' villages and schools gradually disperse. Following the path of urban redevelopment and demolition, these landmarks are vanishing from the world's eyes.

**Exhibition Introduction**
Although a century has passed since Surrealism officially debuted in 1924, it is by no means a finished historical phenomenon. Its explorations of identity, transformation, irrationality, and the questioning of reality and perception continue to be debated in works inspired by the movement today.

Through a "dialogue-based" presentation, this exhibition juxtaposes works from the original 1920s Surrealist movement with creations from subsequent generations. Across four sub-themes—"Collective Dreams," "Magical Metamorphosis," "Playful Irrationality," and "Objects of Desire"—the exhibition demonstrates how Surrealist practice has evolved across generations into a critical and ironic mode of thinking about the present and the future.

This one-hour guided tour will lead visitors through a curated selection of paintings, installations, objects, photography, and film, exploring the rich and diverse facets of Surrealist art.

title:地獄新娘（數位修復版）:
Upon hearing that her sister has drowned, Rui-mei, an overseas Chinese woman, returns to Taiwan in secret. Concealing her true identity, she moves into her brother-in-law’s home as a tutor for her niece, determined to uncover the truth behind the tragedy. As they spend their days together, she not only helps mend the fractured bond between father and daughter but also finds herself falling for her brother-in-law. Amidst the shadows of a haunted mansion, the discovery of a secret diary, and a web of tangled emotions, the truth slowly begins to emerge. But just as her brother-in-law proposes, a deadly conspiracy erupts on the eve of their wedding.

Drawing inspiration from the Brontë sisters and Daphne du Maurier, British author Victoria Holt rose to fame in 1960 with her Gothic romance *Mistress of Mellyn*. After its serialization in Taiwanese newspapers and subsequent publication by Crown Press, the novel ignited a craze for Western romance across the island. Director Hsin Chi masterfully transplants the British suspense and romance of the original novel into the local atmosphere of Tamsui. With sophisticated staging and cinematography, the film not only demonstrates high production standards but also proves that Taiwanese filmmakers were capable of far more than just tragic melodramas—showcasing their ability to master international genres and literary adaptations with a diverse creative vision.
title:地球迷航:
★ 2021 Golden Horse Film Festival

People with autism are naturally unable to understand or learn conventional ways of expressing emotion, making it difficult for them to navigate the complex social interactions of mainstream society. However, they often fixate on specific interests, demonstrating unique talents in fields such as painting, music, and writing. For over a decade, teacher Han Shu-hua has taught painting to individuals with autism, constantly amazed by the unique aesthetic styles of these "stars in the daytime." In 2003, she founded the Duo Bao Art School to provide a creative sanctuary for adults on the autism spectrum. Director Lin Cheng-sheng has been documenting their daily lives since then. Through intimate observation of four individuals, the film explores their interactions with peers, family, and teachers, revealing a unique state of existence and an innate emotional language that differs from the world at large.
title:城市嘻友記:
★ 2018 Toronto International Film Festival Kids
★ 2018 Cinekid Festival - Jury Award for Best Children's Film
★ 2018 Filmfest Hamburg - Michel Award Nomination

Rosie and her mother move to the other side of Brussels into a new apartment building, where she meets her neighbor Moussa, a boy who loves hip-hop. Although the rooftop is strictly off-limits, the two often sneak up there together to play and escape the troubles of their daily lives. It is there that Moussa promises to accompany Rosie to visit her father, who is currently in prison. While her mother wants nothing more to do with him, Rosie’s only wish is for her parents to reconcile and for her family to be whole again. With Moussa’s help, can her dream really come true?

title:夏日大作戰 全新4K修復版: Kenji Koiso, a high school sophomore and math prodigy who narrowly missed representing Japan in the International Mathematical Olympiad, spends his summer working a part-time job as a low-level moderator for "OZ"—a massive virtual world used for everything from shopping to government administration. One day, his crush and senior, Natsuki, invites him to her family home in Ueda, Nagano. To his shock, she suddenly introduces him to her large extended family as her fiancé. Meanwhile, a catastrophic emergency strikes OZ when Kenji’s moderator account is hacked, throwing the entire system into chaos. As Kenji finds himself the prime suspect in a cyber-terrorism investigation, the disruptions in the virtual world begin to spill over into reality, triggering a massive global crisis.
title:大陳大出走 索: This film chronicles the evacuation of Dachen Island residents and their journey to Taiwan under the escort of U.S. naval vessels. Through the experiences of the second generation living in the "Dachen Settlement" of Yonghe, New Taipei, it provides a window into the arduous history and struggles of the Dachen people as they built their lives from the ground up in Taiwan.
title:天字第一號（數位修復版）:
During the War of Resistance against Japan, as the Japanese military occupied Northeast China, a young singer named Cuiying fell in love with a patriotic youth, Zhou Lingyun. However, she was forced to endure the humiliation of marrying the collaborator Chen Zhaoqun, who had long lusted after her. Years later, Chen has become the head of the puppet government’s secret service, desperately hunting for the Nationalist government’s legendary "Special Agent No. 1." Zhou Lingyun, now an agent himself, infiltrates Chen’s household under the guise of his nephew to take up a post in the puppet regime, only to be shocked to discover that his former lover is now his uncle’s second wife. Despite his heartbreak, he finds a new romance and dedicates himself to espionage, vowing to resist the occupation and restore the nation. Little did he know that the formidable "Special Agent No. 1" was actually...

Starring Golden Horse Best Actor Ko Chun-hsiung and the "Lady of a Thousand Faces" Pai Hung, this film is a remake of the 1946 Shanghai sensation directed by Tu Guangqi. As the first locally produced Taiwanese-language spy film, it not only shattered box office records but also ignited a craze for the genre, spawning a five-part series that became a cultural phenomenon and a collective memory for a generation of viewers.
title:奇幻導航: What if you could open a door and step back into the pivotal moments of your life? Sarah and David are two strangers who meet at a mutual friend's wedding. Through a series of unexpected twists of fate, they embark on a bold, fantastical, and beautiful journey. In this whimsical adventure, they revisit key moments from their pasts, gaining a new understanding of how they arrived at the present—and perhaps even finding a chance to rewrite their future.
title:女孩不平凡:
★ 2025 Official Selection, "Vision" Competition, 30th Busan International Film Festival
★ 2025 Nominee, Best Supporting Actress, 62nd Golden Horse Awards

As time flows, love is sought across three cities.

Hong Kong, age 34: She is a director whose latest project has stalled. Trapped in a creative drought and caught at a crossroads with her girlfriend over the question of "marriage," she finds herself paralyzed by indecision.

Taiwan, age 22: She is a stranger studying abroad alone. Wandering the boundary between freedom and bewilderment, she is locked in a volatile, love-hate relationship, burning with a passion that leaves the future blurred.

Macau, age 17: She is a gentle, obedient girl. But after meeting an older student that summer, the windows to her heart are flung open, igniting a sudden longing for the world—even if the cost remains unknown.
title:妳最後留下的歌: Haruto Mizushima, an introvert with no dreams for the future, encounters Ayane Tosaka, a girl blessed with a heavenly voice and immense musical talent. Ayane suffers from developmental dyslexia, making it difficult for her to read or write, yet she harbors a boundless passion for music. Haruto takes on the role of lyricist while Ayane provides the vocals. As their days become a tapestry of interwoven melodies and words, these two individuals—each missing a vital piece of themselves—slowly begin to draw closer.

This one-hour guided tour will lead visitors through a curated selection of paintings, installations, objects, photography, and films, offering an exploration of the rich and diverse facets of Surrealist art.

title:家庭檔案影像的轉生與收納:
Every household has a collection of once-popular audiovisual media—16mm and 8mm film, VHS tapes, DVs, and DVDs—that hold family memories, event recordings, and personal histories. However, in an era where playback equipment is increasingly hard to find, digitizing these formats seems to be the only way to ensure they can be easily viewed and remembered.

In addition to introducing how these formats can be converted into digital files, this event will explore the differences in presentation and preservation between digital files and original media. We will also discuss the potential for building a personal archive through the process of collecting and converting these materials. 16mm and 8mm projectors will be available on-site; participants are welcome to bring their own films if they wish.

title:展覽漫遊84｜超越真實的真相顯影術：電影與超現實主義:
Every path of wandering leads to an unknown, beautiful encounter that sparks the imagination. You are cordially invited to join "The Shrewd Observer" for an Art Promenade—a journey of wonder through the exhibition.

**Time:** Saturday, August 1, 2026 | 14:00–15:30
**Speaker:** Shih Wei-chu | Associate Professor, Department of French, National Central University
**Venue:** Exhibition Rooms D, E, and F, Basement Level
**Meeting Point:** 13:55 in front of the Misty Garden, Basement Level
**Registration:** Online reservation required. Limited to 30 participants. Registration opens July 15 at 10:30 AM.

**Reminders:**
The event is free, but participants must purchase a museum admission ticket and comply with the museum’s bag storage regulations. This activity is recommended for teenagers (junior high and above) and adults. As the tour involves walking and standing within the galleries, please wear comfortable shoes and consider your physical stamina before participating. Registered guests should complete check-in between 13:30 and 13:55; late arrivals will have their spots released to on-site waitlisted visitors.

**Introduction:**
The "Art Promenade" is a creative extension of the traditional expert-led gallery tour. It invites experts and scholars from the art world and various interdisciplinary fields to respond to exhibitions through their unique expertise and creativity. By offering non-traditional modes of appreciation and interpretation, these guides share fresh perspectives with the audience.

For the first generation of Surrealist creators, cinema offered expansive technical possibilities. Through editing, superimposition, collage, and various experimental techniques, they were able to subvert reality, abolish natural laws and logic through fiction, and create absurd, hallucinatory visual effects. In this medium, objects, spaces, and bodies undergo various metamorphoses, carrying diverse symbolic meanings—making film a powerful new vehicle for conveying their creative philosophies.

Today, surreal cinematic plots and imagery have become commonplace for contemporary audiences. This promenade adopts an open, informal approach, inviting the audience to become "Shrewd Observers." Together with speaker Shih Wei-chu, participants will explore selected film segments, images, and the anecdotes behind them, while tracing the marks of Surrealism within contemporary Taiwanese cinema.

**Keywords:** #The Razor that Slices Reason #The Dog that Never Appeared

**About the Speaker:**
Shih Wei-chu is an Associate Professor in the Department of French at National Central University and the former Director of the Taiwan Film Research Center. Her research interests include the history and culture of moving images, small-gauge film history, film aesthetics, contemporary visual arts, and image education. She also served as the co-curator for "The Untitled Volume: Small-Gauge Amateur Films and Others" at the 14th Taiwan International Documentary Festival (2024).

During the height of Japan’s Sengoku period, the formidable warlord Takeda Shingen dominates the land with his brilliant leadership, only to be unexpectedly shot on the battlefield. On his deathbed, he orders his inner circle to keep his passing a secret to maintain morale and deter his rivals. Desperate to maintain order, his retainers recruit a common criminal who bears a striking resemblance to Shingen to serve as his "Kagemusha" (Shadow Warrior). As the political landscape shifts like the wind, enemies surround them like a forest, and war rages like fire, can this double embody Shingen’s tiger-like majesty and remain as immovable as a mountain while commanding the clan?

Early in production, Akira Kurosawa clashed with the original lead actor, leading Tatsuya Nakadai to step in at the last minute to play both Takeda Shingen and the Shadow Warrior. His nuanced performance, seamlessly shifting between the aura of a legendary general and the coarseness of a commoner, helped Kurosawa secure the Palme d'Or and served as a precursor to their collaboration on *Ran*. This epic production nearly collapsed due to a lack of funding, but was saved when renowned directors George Lucas and Francis Ford Coppola stepped in to help secure international financing—a story that has since become legendary in the film world.

title:愛染桂:
2009 Tokyo FILMeX IFF. Kozo, the young heir to a hospital, meets the nurse Katsue at a banquet. Beneath a katsura tree at a temple, they pledge their eternal love, unaware that Katsue is hiding a difficult past as a young widow with a small daughter. The two plan to elope to Kyoto, but Katsue is forced to miss their rendezvous at the last moment when her daughter falls ill. Misunderstandings and regrets soon drive them apart. As Katsue eventually finds her footing through her musical talent, will these two lost lovers ever find their way back to each other?

Based on Matsutaro Kawaguchi’s novel of the same name, this film was a massive hit in Japan and was also deeply beloved by Taiwanese audiences during the colonial era. It went on to profoundly influence the melodramatic conventions of post-war Taiwanese-language cinema, and its classic theme song, "Tabi no Yokaze" (Night Wind of Travel), is still sung today. Although the film spawned numerous sequels and remakes, the original 1938 full-length version of *The Love-Troth Tree* (Parts I and II) is tragically lost. Only a "digest" version, re-edited at the time of its release, remains. While the narrative may feel somewhat fragmented, Kinuyo Tanaka’s delicate and nuanced performance remains profoundly moving even after all these years.
title:感官世界 數位修復版: Abe Sada, a tavern waitress and former celebrated geisha, enters into an illicit affair with her married employer, Kichizo Ishida. Once their affair is exposed, she becomes consumed by the realization that her lover’s body does not belong to her alone. Faced with a reality they cannot change, the two descend into a world of their own, surrendering to a frenzy of carnal desire. title:我只是個士兵:
At the outbreak of the Russo-Ukrainian War, the director volunteered to enlist to document the battlefield firsthand, but military life proved far more difficult to adapt to than he had imagined. As the conflict ground into a stalemate, the bloodshed, cruelty, and isolation began to erode his sensibilities as a chronicler. When death claims loved ones and comrades, leaving only the spread of hatred and rendering life as cheap as weeds, is humanity spread too thin to find a place to dwell? Once one becomes a machine that pulls the trigger without hesitation, is it possible to reclaim the once-familiar comforts of love and family?

Filmed over three and a half years on Ukraine’s frontline, the film follows a young filmmaker who trades his camera for a rifle and joins the Territorial Defence Forces. As war reshapes his life, he moves from storyteller to soldier, documenting fear, loss, and resilience amid chaos.

After the sudden passing of his beloved wife and with his dejected only son facing middle-aged unemployment, an ailing old carpenter realizes his days are numbered. He decides to nail his bedroom door shut and starve himself, instructing his son not to break in until he finds a job so they can continue collecting pension payments to survive. What was once a blissful three-generation household is now fractured by death and mired in suffering; their lives have lost all color overnight. Separated by a single door, can the father and son rediscover their bond, regain the will to live, and see their journey through to the end?

At 80 years old, Tatsuya Nakadai remained a formidable force on screen and stage. Here, he delivers a raw, unadorned performance as a grieving father who has lost the will to live. Through a series of intense close-ups, he masterfully captures the character’s profound despair. He is joined by the talented Kazuki Kitamura and Berlin Silver Bear winner Shinobu Terajima, who both deliver standout performances. Following *Haru’s Journey*, which similarly explored themes of aging and mortality, Nakadai and director Masahiro Kobayashi reunite for this adaptation of a notorious true case, casting a spotlight on the harsh realities of Japan’s aging society. Kobayashi tailored the role specifically for Nakadai, approaching the film with the gravity of writing a final testament. The result is a heavy yet authentic exploration of life and death that confronts the psychological trauma of the post-311 era.

Beginning in 1980, a massive influx of Cambodian and Vietnamese refugees fled the horrors of war to the Thai-Cambodian border, establishing makeshift camps. Five years later, a team from Taiwan’s Kuangchi Program Service traveled to the region, capturing the harrowing reality of refugees risking their lives in minefields to forage for supplies, as well as their resilience as they used song and dance to soothe the spirits of the departed amidst the roar of artillery. As the first Taiwanese documentary to focus on international refugees, it broke the long-standing monopoly of state-owned studios on the Golden Horse Award for Best Documentary and served as a catalyst for the redefinition and critical discussion of the genre in Taiwan.

Drawing from his own memories for this award-winning debut, the director captures a protagonist whose mud-streaked, sorrowful face evokes the lost youth of Antoine Doinel in Truffaut’s *The 400 Blows*—a work of heartbreaking sincerity.
